book.name: Maatoos
book.title: Maatoosin Thaapoono Imbaa Wontea Yesus Kiristoossa Dhacchintan Goynam Giyayno Barjosa Upsino

content: Ogo wodanka Shivea Wannisar, ‘‘Marrato! Barjoyn bitimayno wodano yeskidine. Ogonante seeson waadimanam garayse Barjodar maatee’’ hamaate Barjosa upsinam giyada Yiwda darandar ki yivade.

content.text: yesa woylaminam ashkee; goynamaar kina gaz hayee’ hamayse
ilatea easa upsino darante koda qansime’’

content: hamayse Barjokala qansayse eenna giyea Isiasin giyoono Wannis goynsane.
Wannissa apallo gamalesa sitika ashkadhoonone; yisa karnantear qalbatha kida dhaxe. Kinin itsaynoar seerebee qoa kuribene.
Ogo wodanka Yerusaalem katamanbee, Yiwda peen wulbee, Yordaanoos baynsa gasante dohon peen wulbera eeno Wanniskal nivite ko dahade.
Nivayse yisa seesonam kenin buuthenka, Wannis Yordaanoos baynte keam kida shive.

Ko dahaannaar Parisa eenabee Saduqa eenabera thoothino eeno Wanniskal shiidhana konin nivenka Wannis koam shedayse, ‘‘Yedi qarshi naanato, niven Barjosa wacimera gobayse yenin dhaqoadettsi yeam kiilaa hayne?
Ta keeda seeson waadimanam garayse Barjodar yenin maatonam dhehen payyan waadimanam waadadhee.
Yesa woylaminkaar, ‘Wodi Abraam naasine’ hamayse erimeebhode. Yena ida giye: Barjo yi zaganna kina sennara Abraamna naasi hayayse dhaasana dama ki dame.
Ta haaqanaam taxate dhabayno tesimbho demente kesa wodadhidine. Ogonante payyan aapin ushimina haaqana wulam taxate nuunte koda dhabadhe.

Keeda seeson waadimanam garayse Barjodar yenin maatoono may konin maatoadettsi inta noqoka yeam ida shive; ko dahaannaar isa budonte nivea kidi Manpas Gazanbee nuubeka yeam kida shive. Kidiar idara kantanka sageane. Inta kisa roonsa dunngurin hattear baskana damattine.
Gazgonam qanayse puqulara aapinam kinin bulea anngamo kisa aaninte ko dahade; aapinam payya ashkayse kononte kida kee; puqulanamaar dikimon nuunte kida koqe’’ ki hamade.
Ogo wodanka Yesus Wannis kiam kinin shivoadettsi Galila peera dhaabhayse Yordaanoos bayndar ki nivade.
Wannisaar, ‘‘Iam ha shive koda zaske; haam i shive ya idar haminaa nivaa?’’ hante kiam marana ki dhaabhade.
Yesusaar kina yinin maasenka, ‘‘Yer wulka tipa waadima woam konin zaskenna, ta iam ya shivaa’’ ki hamade. Ogonante Wannis ee hamayse kiam ki shivade.
Yesusaar yinin shiidhadhonsa budonte, saanawa noqora ki utade. Ogo wodanka cecino ko bulimade; Barjosa Manpasinoar waleedettsi hanchayse Yesusdar konin dooqen Wannis ki haapade.
Tapir, ‘‘Inin nashea isa Naasa kaane; inta kanka ida wozadhe’’ hamea upsi cecira ko qansimade.
